Usage: brief show [<fragment>] [flags]

Show the brief a fragment names.

Arguments:
  <fragment>    Part of a brief's name; the index when omitted (optional).

Flags:
      --full    Print the whole brief.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help    Show context-sensitive help.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
